title: Capacity-aware account routing using normalized headroom score
task_summary: Implement capacity-aware account routing by sorting eligible accounts descending by a combined normalized score that balances remaining daily budget and active sessions concurrent capacity.

issues_found: test_concurrent_database_writes wrote rows using a static session_id. In persistent environments, consecutive test runs would accumulate rows and fail the 20-row count assertion.
fixes_applied: Updated test_concurrent_database_writes to use a unique uuid-based session_id per test execution to ensure test runs are completely idempotent.

files_changed.change: Refactored AccountPool.acquire() sorting key to use normalized score and tie-breaker. Surfaced remaining_budget_fraction in status().
Added test_capacity_aware_account_routing. Handled concurrent capacity cleanup in test_account_pool_exhaustion_graceful_backoff.

assumptions_verified.assumption: Score formula works fairly across tiers
assumptions_verified.verification: Validated using mathematical comparisons and test assertions that Free vs Ultra tier accounts are normalized properly.

assumptions_verified.assumption: Tie-breaker falls back to active sessions ascending
assumptions_verified.verification: Confirmed that if remaining budget fractions are equal, accounts with lower active sessions are selected.

decisions.decision: Use -score as the primary element and active_sessions as secondary element in a Python sort-key tuple
decisions.reasoning: Since Python sorts tuples lexicographically, this implements descending order on the score and ascending order on the active sessions in a single, stable, deterministic, and extremely elegant sort key.

self_review.checked: AccountPool, Account status logic, and all test coverage.
changes_made: Explicitly ensured that daily task limits and concurrent limits are looked up directly from PLAN_LIMITS to match has_capacity's implementation style precisely.

notes_for_next_step: Step 11 is complete. Capacity-aware routing behaves beautifully under diverse tier allocations and tie-breaker conditions.
